text: well no.... so i had the textures, the npcs, the grass, all loaded and rendering on compile. Now it has half of those things all broken. why i do NOT know but i know it doesnt work. if its stale then just rebuild the binary the time it took to tell me it could be stale is the same time u could just rebuild it and tell me to try again
resolution: User reported textures/NPCs/grass that previously rendered in the compiled /compiled route were half-broken after a rebuild. Investigation showed the baked gamefile + standalone no-V8 loader rendered everything correctly (4566 instances, 11 materials, 7 terrain meshes, render proof GREEN) — so the bake/compile was intact. The breakage was a stale/mid-race editor binary: the prior build compiled while parallel sessions were live-editing framework/world/constructor.zig and mapfile.zig (NPC lumps + heightfield v2->v3 migration), producing a bad binary. Rebuilding hmsc-int from settled source (tools/rjit ship hmsc-int, with the req_1148 heightfield-gate fix included) restored textures, NPCs, and walls. User confirmed: 'that fixed it'.
